newsitem.title: USA: McClatchy sets five-for-four stock split.
newsitem.headline: McClatchy sets five-for-four stock split.

text.p: McClatchy Newspapers Inc said on Wednesday that its board had set a five-for-four stock split in the form of a 25 percent special stock dividend on its Class A and Class B common stock.
The company also said it maintained its pre-split, quarterly cash dividend of $0.095 per share on the post-split shares, effectively increasing the cash dividend by 25 percent.
Both the stock and the cash dividend are payable on January 2, 1997 to shareholders of record on December 16, 1996, the company said.
Following the stock dividend, the company said it will have about 8.9 million shares of Class A common stock and 28.8 million shares of Class B common stock outstanding.
